title: The path changed.
The way I think did not.
path.body: Civil engineering taught me to respect systems. Data taught me to question them. I still work the same way: input, process, iterate, progress, whether it is a pipeline, a model or a long run.

title: Turning data quality checks
into a reviewable workflow.
body: Deterministic checks score a dataset for completeness, uniqueness, validity and consistency against reference data. AI works around those checks: it suggests rules, summarises findings and proposes fixes for failed values.
A person reviews every correction, and the trusted version is published only after approval.
